wal_commit.note: Must use committed durability metrics only.

accepted.description: Operation accepted into the pipeline but durability not yet guaranteed. Must not be reported as committed TPS.

committed.description: Operation has completed the declared durability protocol (WAL/backend durability as applicable). Primary throughput metric for baselines and gates.

converged.description: Committed state plus secondary indexes/replicas/projections have caught up.

cache.description: Warm process plus intentional hot-set residency (ARC/index/page cache) for hit-path measurement. Never substituted for cold correctness.

cold.description: Process starts with empty import cache, empty page cache for target modules, no warm backend connections, no ARC/index residency.

warm.description: Process has completed declared warmup samples; imports and process-local structures are resident; durable backends may still miss.
